# Microsoft Edge Developer
> Documentation and resources for building, debugging, and optimizing web experiences with Microsoft Edge and related web platform tools.

Microsoft Edge Developer provides documentation for DevTools, Progressive Web Apps, WebView2, browser extensions, testing, and web platform guidance for developers targeting Edge and Chromium-based browsers.

## DevTools
- [Microsoft Edge DevTools documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/devtools/): Overview of Edge DevTools features, workflows, and debugging capabilities.
- [Open DevTools](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/devtools/open/): Ways to open DevTools in Microsoft Edge on different platforms.
- [Inspect, edit, and debug HTML and CSS](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/devtools/css/): Use Elements and Styles tools to inspect and modify page layout.
- [Debug JavaScript](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/devtools/javascript/): Set breakpoints, inspect scope, and troubleshoot JavaScript execution.
- [Network features reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/devtools/network/): Analyze requests, caching, throttling, and network performance issues.
- [Memory problems](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/devtools/memory-problems/): Detect leaks and analyze memory usage in web applications.
- [Performance features reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/devtools/performance/): Record runtime activity and identify rendering and scripting bottlenecks.

## Progressive Web Apps
- [Progressive Web Apps documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/progressive-web-apps/): Guidance for building, installing, and distributing PWAs in Edge.
- [Get started with Progressive Web Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/progressive-web-apps/get-started/): Introduction to core PWA concepts, requirements, and capabilities.
- [How to create a PWA](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/progressive-web-apps/how-to/): Step-by-step guidance for building and enhancing installable web apps.
- [PWAs in Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/progressive-web-apps-chromium/): Edge-specific behaviors and support for Progressive Web Apps.
- [Store and publish PWAs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/progressive-web-apps/how-to/publish/): Publish Progressive Web Apps to app stores and distribution channels.
- [PWA app icon generation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/progressive-web-apps/how-to/icon-theme-color/): Create icons and theme metadata for installable app experiences.

## WebView2
- [WebView2 documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/): Embed web content in native applications using the Edge rendering engine.
- [Get started with WebView2](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/get-started/): Introductory setup for adding WebView2 to desktop applications.
- [WebView2 API reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/reference/): Reference documentation for WebView2 classes, methods, and events.
- [Concepts and architecture](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/concepts/): Learn the WebView2 runtime model, processes, and integration patterns.
- [How-to guides](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/how-to/): Practical tasks for configuration, communication, and customization.
- [Release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/release-notes/): Track SDK, runtime, and prerelease changes across WebView2 versions.

## Extensions
- [Microsoft Edge extensions documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/extensions-chromium/): Build, port, test, and publish browser extensions for Microsoft Edge.
- [Get started with extensions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/extensions-chromium/getting-started/): Create your first Edge extension using Chromium-compatible APIs.
- [Developer guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/extensions-chromium/developer-guide/): Core concepts, architecture, and extension development workflows.
- [API support](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/extensions-chromium/developer-guide/api-support/): Understand Edge support for Chromium extension APIs and differences.
- [Port a Chrome extension](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/extensions-chromium/how-to/port-chrome-extension/): Adapt existing Chrome extensions for Microsoft Edge compatibility.
- [Publish to Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/extensions-chromium/publish/publish-extension/): Submit and manage extensions in the Edge Add-ons store.

## Testing and Automation
- [Testing in Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/test-and-automation/): Overview of browser testing, automation, and compatibility workflows.
- [Use Selenium with Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webdriver-chromium/): Automate Edge with WebDriver and Selenium-based test suites.
- [Playwright and Puppeteer guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/playwright/): Use modern browser automation frameworks with Microsoft Edge.
- [Internet Explorer mode testing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/devtools/ie-mode/): Debug and validate legacy sites running in IE mode.
- [Cross-browser testing tools](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/test-and-automation/test-ie-mode/): Validate compatibility scenarios and enterprise browser behavior.

## Web Platform Guidance
- [Microsoft Edge web platform documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/web-platform/): Guidance on web standards, capabilities, and platform-specific developer topics.
- [Browser interoperability](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/web-platform/how-to/browser-interoperability/): Improve compatibility across browsers using standards-based techniques.
- [Accessibility testing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/devtools/accessibility/): Use DevTools to inspect accessibility trees and identify issues.
- [Storage and cookies guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/web-platform/storage/): Understand storage APIs, cookies, and privacy-related browser behavior.
- [Site permissions and privacy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/web-platform/permissions/): Manage permission prompts and browser privacy capabilities for web apps.

## Tools and Services
- [Microsoft Edge Developer home](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/): Entry point for Edge developer tools, downloads, and resources.
- [Remote tools for Microsoft Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/devtools-guide-chromium/remote-debugging/): Debug web content on remote devices and virtualized environments.
- [DevTools protocol monitor](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/devtools/javascript/reference/): Explore debugging and inspection capabilities exposed through DevTools tooling.
- [Edge Insider channels](https://www.microsoft.com/edge/business/download): Download preview and stable Edge builds for testing and validation.
- [Microsoft Edge Add-ons developer dashboard](https://partner.microsoft.com/dashboard/microsoftedge/overview): Manage extension submissions, analytics, and store publishing workflows.

## Resources
- [Microsoft Edge developer blog](https://blogs.windows.com/msedgedev/): Product updates, feature announcements, and technical articles from the Edge team.
- [What's new in Microsoft Edge DevTools](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/devtools/whats-new/): Release highlights and newly added DevTools capabilities.
- [WebView2 samples](https://github.com/MicrosoftEdge/WebView2Samples): Sample applications demonstrating WebView2 integration patterns and APIs.
- [Microsoft Edge WebDriver downloads](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/tools/webdriver/): Download WebDriver binaries for automating Microsoft Edge.
- [Microsoft Edge status](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/status/): Track implementation status for web platform features in Edge.
- [Microsoft Edge support for developers](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/): Central documentation hub for Edge developer content.
